brands.description: Happi Planet creates effective, eco-friendly home care products powered by nature. From plant-based detergents to natural floor cleaners, we're making sustainable cleaning accessible for Indian households. Our products are tough on stains but gentle on skin and the planet.

target_audience.psychographics: Urban Indian families who want effective cleaning without harmful chemicals. Concerned about skin allergies, environmental impact, and family health. Value transparency in ingredients. Willing to pay premium for sustainable products that actually work.

unique_selling_points: India's 1st foaming formulation for less scrubbing
Refill pods to reduce plastic waste by 80%
Gentle on skin - no rashes or allergies
Works as well as chemical cleaners
Safe for homes with kids and pets

campaign_goals.primary_objective: Increase brand awareness among eco-conscious urban families
campaign_goals.secondary_objective: Drive trial of refill pod system and reduce plastic usage
campaign_goals.campaign_type: Product education + lifestyle integration + sustainability messaging
key_messages: Effective cleaning doesn't need harsh chemicals
Switch to sustainable without compromising performance
Safe for your family, kind to the planet

creator_preferences.engagement_priority: High engagement and authentic community critical
creator_preferences.content_authenticity: Must genuinely care about sustainability and show actual product usage in daily life
creator_preferences.content_style: Authentic home content, educational, family-focused, sustainability angle, before/after cleaning demos
creator_preferences.language_preference: Bilingual Hindi + English preferred for urban reach
must_avoid: Beauty-only content without home care angle

past_successful_partnerships: Sustainability advocates with home care focus
avoid_partnerships_with: Pure luxury lifestyle without eco angle
brands.brand_voice: Friendly, educational, empowering, relatable, slightly playful but informative

must_include: Actual product usage in daily home routine
Refill pod system and plastic reduction angle

challenges: Price sensitivity - need to justify premium
opportunities: Mothers seeking safer products for kids

brands.description: Upside Health is revolutionizing Indian desserts and snacks with no added sugar, no gluten, and no compromise on taste. From guilt-free Tiramisu to protein-rich Laddoos, we're proving that healthy can be delicious. Real ingredients, real taste, zero guilt.

target_audience.income_level: Upper Middle Class to Affluent (₹10L-₹30L+ annual income)
target_audience.psychographics: Health-conscious urban Indians who refuse to compromise on taste. Fitness enthusiasts, diabetics, PCOS/thyroid patients, and calorie-conscious individuals who still crave desserts. Value premium quality, willing to pay 2-3x regular prices for genuinely healthy alternatives.

unique_selling_points: No added sugar, sweetened with dates/jaggery/stevia
No gluten, no preservatives, no seed oils
Premium desserts: Tiramisu, Brownies, Cheesecake, Mithai
Made fresh in Mumbai, delivered across India

campaign_goals.primary_objective: Drive online orders and subscriptions for desserts and mithai
campaign_goals.secondary_objective: Position as THE premium healthy dessert brand in India
campaign_goals.campaign_type: Taste proof + lifestyle aspiration + educational content

creator_preferences.engagement_priority: Balance of reach and engagement - need conversion potential
creator_preferences.content_authenticity: Must demonstrate actual healthy lifestyle - gym content, meal prep, wellness journey
creator_preferences.content_style: Aspirational yet authentic, educational, food porn worthy, fitness integration, honest taste reviews
creator_preferences.language_preference: Primarily English + Hindi for metro audience
must_avoid: Junk food promoters or inconsistent health messaging

budget.affiliate_commission: 12% on all orders from creator codes

past_successful_partnerships: Fitness influencers who share cheat meal alternatives
brands.brand_voice: Honest, aspirational but achievable, slightly cheeky, premium but relatable, unapologetically quality-focused

must_avoid: Weight loss guarantees or medical claims

challenges: High price point vs traditional mithai

special_requirements.product_samples: Must send product samples for genuine reviews
special_requirements.exclusivity: No promotion of direct competitor healthy dessert brands during campaign + 2 months
